title: 2-D Median
text: 输入数组的 2-D Median 值，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Find the median value over} 指定Dimension in which to compute median Entire；{Sort algorithm} 指定 Algorithm to sort input array、{Dimension} 指定自定义维度、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 用于防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 输入数组 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output median values scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Sort algorithm
params.values: Algorithm to sort input array Quick sort (default) | Insertion sort

params.name: Find the median value over
params.values: Dimension in which to compute median Entire input (default) | Each row | Each column | Specified dimension

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 用于防止定点工具覆盖数据类型的选项 off (default) | on
